also.hook: Badrinarayanan helped write one of computer vision's most-cited deep learning papers, SegNet, before moving into frontier AI research at DeepMind, and now leads AI development at Wayve, applying end-to-end learned driving models rather than the hand-coded rule systems most autonomous vehicle companies rely on.
